name: Executive Order 14412: Securing the Nation Against Advanced Cryptographic Attacks
update_frequency: One-time executive order with dated implementation deadlines
known_limitations: The order creates federal migration, procurement, pilot, and guidance deadlines, but it does not prove agency compliance, critical-infrastructure execution, vendor readiness, appropriations, or completion of the required future rulemaking.
automation_notes: Track the 30-, 90-, 180-, and 270-day deliverables, the NIST pilot, CISA guidance, proposed FAR rules, and 2030-2031 system-transition deadlines. Do not mark an institution migrated without its own implementation evidence.
notes: Phase 55B institutional migration source. Executive Order 14412, dated June 22, 2026, directs federal PQC leadership, migration planning, key-establishment and digital-signature deadlines, a NIST pilot, critical-infrastructure assistance, and procurement rulemaking.
